name: import-step-assembly
description: An assembly read from a STEP file written by SketchBillet: a 20 x 10 x 5 mm block and a pin part (2 mm radius, 10 mm long) used twice, one standing on top at 5, 5, 5 and one turned to stick out of the right side along x. The pin's shape is in the file once, with two placed copies; reading it back gives three solids where the copies were put: 1000 + 2 * pi * 2^2 * 10 = 1251.327412 mm^3, from 0, 0, 0 to 30, 10, 15 mm.
